About Us

Landscaping in Godalming

On time, done properly, and left better than I found it.

I'm Freddy, born and raised in Surrey. I run The Greensman from Elstead and have been trading since 2024. I lay patios and paths, put up fences and decking, renovate tired gardens and lay new lawns. I still look after gardens week to week too.

Every quote is free and there's no call-out fee. I guarantee my work.

Why Choose The Greensman

  • Free quotesI come out, look at the job and give you a clear quote.
  • No call-out feeYou don't pay for me to come and have a look.
  • Guaranteed workI stand behind every job I do.
  • LocalBased in Elstead, working across Godalming and west Surrey.
